body.title: Replace deleted review isolation inventory entries
body.summary: Update store-isolation inventories to exercise current real coverage after the repaired fixtures are available. Preserve default-path negative evidence and deliberate-opening positive controls for graph and vectors.
acceptanceChecks: Each removed fixture entry has a mapped current test/control, with real child execution proven by exit status and TAP cases; empty, skipped-only or failed child runs cannot prove isolation.
Isolated HOME is established before application imports, and no live default LMDB/Lance artifact is created by the applicable current fixtures.
Deliberate default-store-opening positive controls remain and prove the audit can detect violations.
Only review-related inventory drift changes; unrelated failing fixture contracts remain visible in evidence rather than being removed or reclassified to force a pass.
Replacement suites contain named applicable assertions with positive TAP counts and verified normal cleanup; forced exit alone never proves closure or isolation.

tests.name: Current isolation inventories execute real tests and detect deliberate default-store opening
